minutes.summary: The Lunenburg Planning Board held one public hearing, approving a minor site-plan modification at 475 Lemonster Shirley Road to add manufacturing as a permitted use alongside warehouse distribution, and continued two other pending hearings (10 Parmentor Road and 860 New West Townsend Road) to August 24 for lack of a quorum able to vote. The board voted to accept and approve the town's master plan after roughly five years of work, and discussed forming a leaner master plan implementation committee to be housed with the Planning Board itself rather than the Select Board.

what_happened.line: The Planning Board voted to accept and approve the town's master plan after roughly five years of work.
The board approved a site-plan modification at 475 Lemonster Shirley Road adding manufacturing as a permitted use alongside warehouse distribution.
Hearings for 10 Parmentor Road and 860 New West Townsend Road were continued to August 24 because the board lacked a quorum able to vote.

The board leaned toward forming its own master plan implementation committee rather than asking the Select Board to do it, and plans to vote on disbanding the old steering committee at the next meeting.

why_it_matters: Adopting the master plan sets the framework the town will use for zoning bylaws and land-use decisions brought to future town meetings.
The site-plan approval allows manufacturing use, alongside existing warehouse distribution, at that Lemonster Shirley Road property.
Residents following the Parmentor Road or New West Townsend Road proposals, or the fate of the master plan steering committee, should watch the August 24 meeting.
